Invite an external user (by email) as a guest on this customer.

A brand-new email gets a Clerk org invitation (Clerk emails them + handles
signup); on accept they become a guest scoped to this customer. An email
that already belongs to a *guest* of this org is granted access directly.
An email belonging to an existing non-guest Unisson user is rejected — a
full member can't be turned into a guest.
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Edit an accepted guest's agent allowlist and access expiry.

Replaces both settings on the ``customer_guests`` grant. Setting a future
``expires_at`` on an expired guest re-grants their access (the grant row is
never deleted on expiry — access is blocked at read time, so it simply
becomes live again).
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Revoke an accepted guest's access to this customer.

Removes the customer grant. ``is_guest`` is never cleared (no path to a
silent privilege gain). When this was the guest's **last** grant in the org,
we also remove them from the org entirely — drop their Clerk membership and
unlink them locally (``organization_id=None``) — so they can no longer sign
in and use chat / their own connectors with no customer access. Their Clerk
account survives, so the same email can be re-invited later.
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Revoke a pending guest invitation.

Also revokes the underlying Clerk invitation so the recipient can't accept
it later and join the org as a full member (which would happen if no
pending guest invitation remained to flag them on join).
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
